## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd - Downtown Dubai.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The tallest building in the world deserves a special experience. And that's exactly what this is.
>
> With this ticket you'll get VIP treatment during every part of your visit to the building they call the 'Burj'. Personal reception, complimentary drinks, access to the luxe lounge, and of course, spectacular views at the top from the 124th, 125th and 148th floor.
>
> You'll feel like a rock star, and, for the hopeless romantics, come at sunset to get the most spectacular views.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €110.90. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 172 ratings and 68 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
